description: Defines the BackoffEntry class for managing exponential back-off logic in networking, including policies, request tracking, and timing calculations.

classes.name: BackoffEntry
classes.description: Manages exponential back-off timing for network requests based on a specified policy.

methods.name: InformOfRequest
methods.description: Informs the backoff entry of a request success or failure.

methods.name: ShouldRejectRequest
methods.description: Determines if requests should be rejected based on backoff timing.

methods.name: GetReleaseTime
methods.description: Returns the time after which requests can be resumed.

methods.name: GetTimeUntilRelease
methods.description: Returns the duration until requests can be resumed.

methods.name: BackoffDurationToReleaseTime
methods.description: Converts a backoff duration into a release time.

methods.name: SetCustomReleaseTime
methods.description: Sets a custom time to release requests, e.g., for Retry-After headers.

methods.name: CanDiscard
methods.description: Checks if the backoff entry can be discarded.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the backoff entry to initial state.

methods.name: failure_count
methods.description: Returns the number of consecutive failures.

methods.name: GetTimeTicksNow
methods.description: Returns current time, using the provided clock if available.
